text:
Mina: Quick thread to lock the rollout play for the region-aware routing change. Goal: safe staged rollout, dark-launch validation, A/B quality checks, and a single emergency disable. Who takes which piece?

Rick: I'll own the flag mechanics and the disable endpoint. Proposed id: `route-regional-nextgen`. Will push YAML to flagstore + Console.

Lao: Proposed rollout flow: 20m dark-launch (shadow-only), 5% NA for 45m, 15% NA+EU for 3h, 35% global for 8h. Automated gates to stop or rollback. Manual approval required to touch Dedicated pools.

Mina: Launch gates we want (draft):
- p99 latency delta <= 22ms
- absolute error rate delta <= 0.06%
- unit token cost delta <= 7%
- eval MRT drop <= 0.45
- semantic drift <= 0.58
Please call out anything missing.

Vish: Add a telemetry-only phase where we route 1% and only collect traces. Low risk, good for instrumentation checks.

Rick: Flag snippet (ops YAML):
```yaml
flag: route-regional-nextgen
phases:
  - mode: shadow
    duration: 1200
  - mode: telemetry
    pct: 1
    duration: 1800
  - pct: 5
    regions: [NA]
    duration: 2700
  - pct: 15
    regions: [NA,EU]
    duration: 10800
  - pct: 35
    regions: [global]
    duration: 28800
manual_targets: [Dedicated]
kill_endpoint: /ops/flags/route-regional-nextgen/disable
metrics: [p99_latency,error_rate,token_cost,eval_mrt,semantic_drift]
```

Rick: Kill command for runbook:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://ops-api.redwood.internal/flags/route-regional-nextgen/disable" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"reason":"emergency rollback","by":"ops"}'
```

infra-bot: Infra pre-check: capacity OK for NA/EU. Autoscaler headroom 20%. Alert rules for p95/p99 latency spikes and error bursts provisioned.

Emma: Preflight checklist I want: 10m synthetic warmup at 5qps to prime caches; smoke routing tests; logging/trace verification. Also a 30m shadow compare step with diffs.

Lao: For enterprise / Dedicated accounts: require explicit CSM opt-in for top-30 paying customers. Also add an allowlist so those tenants never get auto-ramped.

Mina: A/B evaluation plan: run seeded eval (1k prompts) during 5% and 15% windows. If MRT drops > 0.45 or semantic drift > 0.58, abort. Emma can own the eval runs.

Emma: Will do. I'll post diffs and a small BLEU-like drift metric to the rollout dashboard during the canaries.

Rick: Automation vs manual increases? I propose auto-up to 35% while gates are green, but block enabling Dedicated until ops + product approval. Also require manual approval to exceed 35%.

infra-bot: Auto-rollback thresholds configured: p99 delta > 35ms OR error rate delta > 0.1% OR semantic_drift > 0.58 OR eval_mrt_drop > 0.45. On trigger, system sets flag -> disabled, notifies #eng-oncall and product.

Lao: Suggest adding a short 15m hold after each phase where we watch for tail regressions before auto-increase. Helps catch slow failures.

Mina: Good. Add that to runbook. Also include a post-rollout regression check at 24h for quality drift and cost.

Rick: Ops note: I'll add ACLs so only ops/product leads can flip Dedicated or global-all at >35%.

Emma: Support/CS prep: draft canned responses explaining short latency blips and link to status. I'll prepare a mini-FAQ for CSMs.

Vish: Minor ask: add request ID correlation and embedding-cache hit rate to the dashboard so we can diagnose cost spikes quickly.

Mina: Owners + ETAs:
- Rick: implement flag + disable endpoint + ACLs (ETA: EOD tomorrow)
- Emma: schedule A/B evals + post dashboard widgets (ETA: start with dark-launch)
- Lao: write orchestration runbook, include hold windows (ETA: morning)
- Vish: add telemetry metrics to dashboard (ETA: today)
- infra-bot/SRE: finalize alerts (ETA: today)
- Mina: publish launch card and pick a low-traffic mid-week slot (ETA: tomorrow AM)

Rick: One final runbook item: include a rollback postmortem trigger if we do an emergency disable with >1% user impact.

Mina: Agreed. I'll add that and circle back. If nobody objects I'll lock this plan and start sign-offs.

Lao: :thumbsup:

Emma: queued the eval infra.

Vish: dashboard updates live in staging.

Rick: pushing flag YAML to flagstore PR now.

Mina: Thanks all 11 I'll add these owners to the product card and tag for sign-off.
